rationale_evidence.anchor: Lens / Source table: Williamson, Pritchard, Fagin et al., Gaerdenfors, Gelfond & Kahl, Brandom, Searle, Dretske, Floridi, Roberts, Aggoun & Elliott, Rudin -- What it contributed / Current architectural meaning
rationale_evidence.statement: Synthesis table converting twelve prior external-lens research conclusions into current architectural meanings: Williamson (knowledge is factive, keep KnowledgeAttribution distinct from belief/evidence/probability/measurement); Pritchard (prevent epistemic state, knowledge and representation from being collapsed); Fagin et al. (participant and epistemic state are core candidates, projections are agent-relative); Gaerdenfors (knowledge/epistemic state is temporally dynamic and non-monotonic, via expansion/contraction/revision); Gelfond & Kahl (reasoning is regime-specific; historical inputs and derived conclusions must be separable); Brandom (knowledge-bearing content has inferential/normative relations, assertion is not knowledge itself); Searle (institutional meaning belongs to bounded contexts/regimes, not universally to Kernel); Dretske (information is an input relation, not automatically knowledge); Floridi (boundary and representation must remain distinct); Roberts (measurement governance must validate every quantitative regime, no arbitrary KnowledgeScore); Aggoun & Elliott (probabilistic filtering is a regime, not the definition of KnowledgeOS); Rudin (use the minimum mathematical structure justified by a regime, do not impose analysis on the Kernel).
